authority: Pinned grading authority distilled from Broadcom compatibility, interoperability, lifecycle, and VCF 9.0 upgrade publications; it is not a search transcript.

supportBoundary.statement: The 8.x appliance line has no supported in-place upgrade to 9.0; deploy VCF Operations for Logs 9.0 fresh and transfer at most 90 days of log data before retiring the old appliance.
